ITEM PARAGRAPHS
The
American
mink
has
been
present
in
Iceland
since
the
1930's
and
despite
heavy
hunting
since
1939
the
species
has
become
well
established
.
The
ecosystem
in
Iceland
is
simpler
than
in
other
areas
where
mink
are
found
;
the
only
other
mammalian
predator
is
the
arctic
fox
.
Direct
competition
between
these
species
appears
to
be
minimal
although
the
arctic
fox
will
sometimes
chase
mink
and
disturb
them
while
foraging
.
Iceland
is
therefore
an
ideal
place
to
study
undisturbed
feeding
behaviour
and
ecology
of
mink
.
